purpose: Paper-only activation artifact binding an explicit schema-adoption approval packet to canonical repository facts (manifest id/checksum, expected-schema fingerprint, target identity, allowlist). Does NOT activate the canonical Production stream and does NOT execute any migration. A separately approved operator/runner consults this gate before executing; execution and ledger append remain out of scope for this artifact.
activation_rule: A separately approved adoption baseline attestation is required before canonical-migrations.json status changes from ADOPTION_REQUIRED to ACTIVE. This artifact records that the paper gate passed; it does not itself flip the status.
